text: Let me share my experience with this clinic. I was getting orthodontic treatment from a doctor who also owns the clinic. It was a long time ago, I don't remember the exact date of the promotion, but last year I asked if I would get a free retainer upon completion of my treatment and free braces if the treatment wasn't finished. I was told that I had missed too many appointments. There was no prior warning or notification about how many missed appointments would void the promotion. Okay, no problem. Later, the doctor said my case required dental implants because I was missing a front tooth. During the implant procedure, they needed to adjust and enlarge the tooth cavity and install spring pins. At the time, I didn't even know there would be additional costs because the doctor didn't inform me about the details or ask if I was okay with that. That was the first issue. Okay, no problem. More recently, after the implant was placed, I had to have it corrected twice. The first time, the implant was crooked, and it was crooked from the moment I left the operating room. I had the front desk staff take a picture after the procedure and they said they would inform the doctor. When I came back and told the doctor that my tooth was crooked from the start, they said, "That's impossible! Could you really chew that hard?" and laughed. I told them the front desk staff had taken a picture. (I thought I was going to have to pay again.) I had an appointment for a crown and another round of dental work. The second time, they put in a huge dental implant, about the size of a tamarind seed, and it was on a front tooth. After the procedure, they scheduled a follow-up appointment and asked if my tooth looked too big. I said yes. Then they said they would make it smaller, but I didn't know what they were going to do or if I'd have to pay again. I thought it might be part of a dental implant promotion. When it came time to pay, the counter staff said there was a filling charge of 700 baht and a braces installation charge of 1500 baht. I was confused. The doctor didn't mention any additional charges! She was silent and just said, "Yes, there's a filling charge." That was it. I feel like I can't take it anymore with this clinic. Just the braces alone cost tens of thousands of baht, and now the dental implant is almost 40,000 baht, bringing the total to nearly 100,000 baht. Is this acceptable? “As a doctor, shouldn't you always inform the patient before performing any procedure or if there are any additional costs?”

text: I will review what I have experienced throughout my orthodontic treatment here. I do not intend to discredit anyone. The doctor never came on time for the appointment at 10.30, sometimes at 12.00, sometimes at 13.00. When I asked the staff at the counter if the doctor did not know that he had an appointment or the patient was waiting, the staff replied that "The doctor is in Sukhumvit. It takes time to travel." It is your responsibility to make an appointment with the patient. Why don't you allow extra time? Sometimes, after making an appointment, you call to reschedule even though you have already arrived at the dental clinic. Sometimes, the patient has to wait for hours. The worst thing is that the doctor knew that he was late and asked the doctor who was responsible for scaling to adjust the braces for us. He asked first if it was convenient for another doctor to adjust. If it was not convenient, we could wait for the doctor. Another thing I am not very happy about is that before getting braces, there was no interesting promotion. There was fluoride coating after scaling, and there were 16-17 free items. None of them were included. Even though the braces were caught in the mouth until it was all wounded. The promotion stated that there was free wax to prevent the braces from cutting (at that time, it had not been removed, but now it should have been removed). When I asked the staff at the counter, they said that there were no free items included. All of the reviews are because we want to share what we have experienced because getting braces is not cheap. If anyone wants to get braces, we recommend finding a good clinic.
